code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    line = nonbg.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hlines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != bg for v in row) > sum(v == bg for v in row)]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h)) > sum(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h))]
    hlines = [r for r in hlines if any(grid[r][c] != line for c in vlines)]
    vlines = [c for c in vlines if any(grid[r][c] != line for r in hlines)]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(hlines, hlines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(vlines, vlines[1:]):
            vals = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0] not in (bg, line) and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

True from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    line = nonbg.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hlines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != bg for v in row) > sum(v == bg for v in row)]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h)) > sum(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h))]
    hlines = [r for r in hlines if any(grid[r][c] != line for c in vlines)]
    vlines = [c for c in vlines if any(grid[r][c] != line for r in hlines)]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(hlines, hlines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(vlines, vlines[1:]):
            vals = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0] not in (bg, line) and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
